title: Renovation and refurbishment
summary: Full or partial renovations of apartments and houses, with a single person responsible from project to handover.
intro: We handle the complete job: survey, selective demolition, masonry, installations, coverings and finishes. We coordinate every trade and keep one point of contact with you, from day one to handing over the keys.
includes: Survey and assessment of the existing building
Masonry, plasterboard and levelling of walls and floors
Coordination of electrical, plumbing and HVAC work
Site cleaning and a joint final inspection

title: Interior finishes
summary: Wall and floor coverings, skirtings, ceilings and trims. The detail that defines the final result.
intro: Finishes are the part of the work you see every day. We install ceramic and stone coverings, suspended ceilings, skirtings and trims, with measurements checked before installation and aligned joints.
includes: Ceramic, natural stone and porcelain coverings
Suspended ceilings, coving and recessed lighting

image.alt: Detail of a stone worktop in raking light

title: Painting and coatings
summary: Interior and exterior painting, surface preparation and technical or decorative coatings.
intro: Good painting depends on preparation. We repair cracks, treat damp and level surfaces before applying paints and coatings suited to each room and exposure.
includes: Interior painting of walls, ceilings and joinery

image.alt: Renovated living room with light walls and timber floor

title: Joinery and window frames
summary: Installation of doors, window frames and bespoke joinery with precise fitting.
intro: Doors, wardrobes, kitchens and window frames only work well when they are measured and levelled properly. We measure on site, install and adjust each element until it closes and slides as it should.
includes: Adjustment and repair of existing joinery

image.alt: Large framed windows in a stone house

title: Plumbing and installations
summary: Installation and replacement of water and drainage networks and sanitary fittings.
intro: We replace old pipework, fix leaks and install sanitary fittings in kitchens and bathrooms. We pressure-test the networks before closing walls and keep a record of the layout.
includes: Installation of sanitary ware, shower trays and taps
